slots._boundary: 🔴 THE SLOT BOUNDARY IS FB_ShredderSequencer ALONE AS THE BLOCK UNDER TEST, WITH iDB_MotorFwdRevSystem_Shredder UNAVOIDABLY INSIDE THE STIMULATED LOOP.
